The '''Larch''' is a type of [[above ground]] [[tree]]. It is found in [[temperate]] [[forest]]s and occasionally in [[taiga]] regions. Like the overwhelming majority of overland trees, larch [[wood]] is brown and produces brown products.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] larches for their ''cones'' and their ''needles''.


[[File:Mélèze en Automne.JPG|thumb|center|300px|The larch. Admired for its ''needles''.]]


{{D for Dwarf}}
With proper instruction, the larch can be recognised from quite a long way away.
